nodes.label: First-release multi-candidate intention rules.  The public v3.2 DTO deliberately
Return ``default`` only for unavailable/non-numeric input, not for zero.
Stable internal contract consumed by every intention evaluator.
Return the explicit v1 'no enabled intention reached threshold' value.
Select one primary result and keep all candidates in stable order.
Flatten candidate evidence without leaking internal scoring metadata.
Evaluate every enabled v1 rule independently.      A statutory no-fly intrusion
